findings.description: When a batch contains a plan missing expiration_date, this assignment includes tenant_id: None in the promised dict[str, SubscriptionPlan]. The added unit test fails (three entries instead of two), both backend type checkers reject the assignment, and the cache wrapper returns and serializes the invalid value. Omit the failed tenant while continuing to process the remaining plans.
findings.failureMode: A malformed plan produces an extra None result rather than only validated plans; the new unit test and the required backend type-checking gate fail, and the cache wrapper propagates the invalid value.
findings.title: Skip invalid plans instead of inserting None

findings.description: The required Basedpyright and Mypy checks both reject this declaration: TypedDict classes can contain only field annotations. SubscriptionPlan instances are ordinary dicts, so this __str__ override does not run at runtime either. Remove the method from the schema to restore the type-checking gate.
findings.failureMode: The required backend type-checking gate fails on every run because SubscriptionPlan contains an invalid method declaration.
findings.title: Remove the method from the TypedDict schema

findings.description: With the supported REDIS_USE_CLUSTERS configuration, tenant_plan:tenant-1 and tenant_plan:tenant-2 map to different hash slots. RedisCluster.mget requires all keys in one slot, so this call fails and the wrapper fetches every tenant from billing even when all plans are cached. Use a pipeline of single-key GETs or the cluster client's non-atomic multi-get so multi-tenant batches can hit the cache.
findings.failureMode: A multi-tenant batch on Redis Cluster always raises a cross-slot error at mget and falls back to billing, defeating the cache's API-load reduction for this supported deployment configuration.
findings.title: Use a cluster-safe bulk cache read

findings.description: The new cache boundary validates an unconfigured TypedDict: a cached plan containing unexpected_field is accepted and silently stripped rather than rejected. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 14 requires Pydantic v2 DTOs to forbid undeclared fields by default. Validate cached entries with an extra='forbid' DTO so malformed entries become cache misses.
findings.failureMode: A cached JSON object with extra undeclared fields is accepted, violating the mandatory extra-forbid validation contract at the new cache input boundary.
findings.title: Forbid undeclared fields in cached plan validation

findings.description: If Redis mget raises a connection error, this new log omits the tenant_ids whose lookup failed. No logging filter supplies tenant context. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 23 requires relevant object identifiers; include tenant_ids in the fallback message or structured logging context.
findings.failureMode: A reachable Redis outage produces a fallback log with no affected tenant identifiers, violating the required backend logging context.
findings.title: Identify the batch in Redis fallback logs

findings.description: On a pipeline connection failure, this message contains no tenant IDs for the plans that were not cached. The global logging filter supplies only request/trace IDs. Add bulk_plans' tenant IDs to satisfy AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 23 and make cache-write failures attributable.
findings.failureMode: A reachable Redis pipeline failure logs no affected tenant identifiers, violating the backend logging-context mandate.
findings.title: Identify tenants when cache writes fail

findings.description: A temporary Redis connection error is recoverable here: the method falls back to billing and can complete successfully. logger.exception emits ERROR, contrary to AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 23's requirement to log retryable events at warning level. Use logger.warning(..., exc_info=True) for this recoverable cache failure.
findings.failureMode: A transient Redis mget outage generates an ERROR log even though the operation recovers through billing, violating the required retryable-event logging level.
findings.title: Log retryable Redis read failures at warning level

findings.description: A transient Redis connection failure during pipeline execution is best-effort and retryable; the method still returns the fetched plans. logger.exception emits ERROR, violating AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 23. Log this recoverable cache-write event at warning level with exc_info instead.
findings.failureMode: A transient cache-write failure emits ERROR despite successful plan retrieval and a retryable cache operation, violating the required retryable-event logging level.
findings.title: Log retryable cache-write failures at warning level

findings.description: This new summary logs only hit/miss counts, with no tenant identifiers or structured tenant context. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 23 requires tenant/app/workflow identifiers in backend logs; the logging filter adds only request/trace IDs. Include the batch's tenant_ids so a batch-job cache summary can be attributed to its tenants.
findings.failureMode: A normal bulk cache lookup emits a tenant-unattributable summary, violating the mandatory backend logging-context rule.
findings.title: Identify tenants in the cache-summary log

findings.description: The cache-write summary reports only len(bulk_plans), not the tenant identifiers for those writes. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 23 requires tenant/app/workflow identifiers in backend logging context, and the global filter does not add them. Include the cached tenant IDs in this summary.
findings.failureMode: A normal cache fill emits an unattributable write-summary log in violation of the backend logging-context mandate.
findings.title: Identify tenants in the cache-write summary

findings.failureMode: The added expiration test mixes assertion and setup phases instead of the three distinct sections required by the pytest AAA mandate.
findings.title: Keep the expiration test in Arrange–Act–Assert order
